cohort: 77 women who underwent C-section and received opioid prescriptions for postoperative pain management
finding: This study suggests that an individualized approach to opioid prescribing after C-sections, potentially incorporating more nonopioid analgesics, may reduce excess opioid prescriptions and mitigate potential risks associated with improper storage and disposal.
mod_finding: The study focused on opioid use after cesarean sections.
